scope: strict macOS native RGBA32F top-level AP1 DAG, 24 MP FIT with AppKit drawable, 24/60 MP preview ROI, 60 MP 032 frozen delivery

method.workbench: same binary and parameters, one cold, five warmups and 30 measured for each 032 rendition and the double-target component. Strict wgpu then strict 039 sequentially.
method.variant: Same RAW bytes, FlashRaw library, graph operation order, weights and photographic values. Runtime graph and frozen-version instance UUIDs differ between processes.
method.dagWall: Swift bridge render call through backend completion. wgpu included pipeline build on each target's first tile. Device open separate. Submit and wait includes driver commands and internal output initialization, and is a subinterval of render wall.
method.transport: Zero whole-frame CPU upload/readback within the DAG. wgpu output init, separate DRT/blit and codec readback are outside that count.
method.decodedFiles: One deterministically repeated file per format and backend. Full sample code-value difference in native decoded YUV420. dav1d 1.5.4 via avifdec 1.4.2, FFmpeg 8.1.2 MJPEG.

preview.scope: resident display-linear HDR texture before AppKit presentation

drawable24MP.scope: live scene exposure command to joined AppKit Metal drawable; warm FIT SDR derivative, no HID or photon readback
